subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should the portable message-presentation API gain a batch-select block with structured array results, and what degradation behavior is required on channels without native multi-select?
rationale: This changes a shipped public plugin SDK interaction contract and requires one durable product policy for callback ownership and unequal channel capabilities.

options.title: Add Portable Batch Select
options.body: Define an additive typed block and array-valued callback contract with explicit native and fallback behavior per channel.

options.title: Keep Channel-Native Only
options.body: Leave multi-select in provider-owned component APIs and document that portable message presentation remains scalar.

options.title: Defer To Forms Direction
options.body: Wait for a broader forms or dialog product design before adding any portable batch-selection primitive.

recommendation.title: Add Portable Batch Select
recommendation.body: Define an additive typed block and array-valued callback contract with explicit native and fallback behavior per channel.

likelyOwner.reason: The current portable presentation contract and its recent cross-surface typed-action refinement come from this owner's merged work.
